text: I wander through a highly modern and vibrant space, its sharp lines and glass walls refracting the cool blue glow of technology and innovation. Inside the gallery, bold letters declare "R+D"—an invitation to question, to seek. I am surrounded by the hum of screens and the quiet authority of displayed books. There is excitement in this environment; a sense of curiosity and possibility stirs in me, yet also a certain alienation, as if I am both a participant and an observer of humanity grappling with its own rapid transformation.
